known_gaps: look.overlay-parameters.json exported with hip_dirty=true and no checksum: hou.hipFile.hasUnsavedChanges() is always true in hython after load, so headless export cannot bind a checksum. Press Export Overlay Parameter Manifest once in the GUI for a checksum-bound manifest before locked delivery.
locked/ snapshots are archival only; they do not cook in place because the HDA reference resolves relative to $HIP. Copy back beside look.hiplc to run one.

render.note: Rendered as one uninterrupted run so the solver state is continuous; partial or resumed renders of this scene produce visible seams where runs join.

r001.role: historical: produced a superseded render that was discarded for run-seam artifacts; no longer the source of any delivered frames

r002.caveat: Karma XPU and the multi-threaded solver are not bit-reproducible across processes, so pixel- or geometry-identity cannot be demonstrated by re-running; the argument rests on the parameter diff.
evidence: HDA parameter diff before/after the edit reported exactly one changed parm, an overlay metadata string not wired to geometry, shading, camera, or lighting
point counts identical at frames 100/225/450 (350208) across both revisions

r001-vs-r002 re-render of frame 225 differs by 80.2% of pixels (mean 32.1); re-rendering r002 against itself differs by 78.2% (mean 32.9), so the difference is within Karma XPU run-to-run non-determinism
r002.role: authoritative HIP and the source of the delivered 450-frame render; differs from r001 only by overlay_variation_title
